offer.text: The whole family's gathering under one roof for once, and I'll not have them go hungry. Bring me eight good cuts of cooked beef and we'll set a table to remember.

accept.text: Wonderful! I'll start laying the places.

decline.text: We'll make do with thin soup, then. Again.

in_progress.text: How's the beef coming? They'll be here by sundown.

ready.text: Eight fine cuts — the table will groan with it!

complete.text: Laughter and full plates under one roof. You gave us a night we'll always remember.
